newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady at lower levels, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady at lower levels, trade thin.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were holding steady at the lower levels in late Friday trade. Barge prices clawed back some of their early losses while underlying arbitrage interest buoyed cargo prices, traders said.
They said business was thin with no sign of end-user demand from inland European markets, while take-up for shipment to the U.S., though still supportive, had died down a little.

Superplus and Eurograde cargoes continued to find some support in underlying demand from the U.S., but traders said prices for low octane grades remained depressed as demand from eastern Europe stayed thin.
